I ran `cargo test -p athena-core --lib status` (71 passed) and `cargo test -p athena-core --lib hestia` (83 passed); both include the new test and the two existing spec tests. I did not run the test on the base tree, because I may not change files. The diff shows the base lacks the restarts row, so the test's first assertion would fail there. Athena's recorded CI results show fmt, clippy and the full test suite passing. The diff touches only CHANGELOG.md, status.rs and docs/spec.toml, all of them deliverables, and the CHANGELOG entry is accurate. I found no soundness problem.
